# Power simulation (generated by analysis/power.py; dev pilots, design §7.4)

δ = 3 pp, α = 0.05, 2000 simulations; power at the first Holm step (α/6) and at α. Scenario discordance = pilot × {0.5, 1, 1.5}; 'infeasible' = the effect exceeds the discordance. H1d and H2a are re-examined in 02_selfverdict_tables.md and 02_power_h2a_tables.md.
